answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 8036 Country: OM Title: Aslam o alaikum after passing urine i take care of last few drops a lot. Clean and wipe the part with toliet paper. But when i come out and do wozo i feel tht sum drops have come out.to check it nw,it is difficult. Tel me the better way so i cn avoid the impurity. Wht to do abt wht comes later in my mind tht whether few drops cam out or not.jazak ALLAH KHAIRAN Question: Aslam o alaikum after passing urine i take care of last few drops a lot. Clean and wipe the part with toliet paper. But when i come out and do wozo i feel tht sum drops have come out.to check it nw,it is difficult. Tel me the better way so i cn avoid the impurity. Wht to do abt wht comes later in my mind tht whether few drops cam out or not.jazak ALLAH KHAIRAN Answer ID: 8036 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1837/1528=B/1429) When you doubtful of the drops, you should go to toilet and confirm it. If there are drops, then perform wudhu again. If there was no drop, then it was merely a movement in veins, it will not break the wudhu. Note : You should walk a little or lie for some time after urination, then make wudhu . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
